html:
The Circosta Law Firm assists companies, individuals and institutions in several African countries in commercial law, international contracts, compliance and dispute resolution, with a particular focus on relations between Africa and Europe. Countries where we operate:

  • Egypt
  • Ghana
  • Ivory Coast
  • Kenya
  • Madagascar
  • Morocco
  • Senegal
  • South Africa
  • Tanzania
  • Togo
  • Tunisia
